description: This file is a Markdown documentation outlining how to handle form data in FastAPI applications. It explains the use of the `Form` class, how to import it, define form parameters, and details about form encoding types such as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and `multipart/form-data`. The content includes code snippets, technical notes, tips, and references to external resources like the `python-multipart` library and MDN docs.
